subject: Proposal: short-term evaluation credit pool and governance
messages:
From: Alex Porter <aporter@opsly.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@opsly.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 2-week side-by-side eval + additional credits

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looked great. We're running a constrained head-to-head pilot next month against LatticeAI and I'd like to request a small, time-boxed credit pool so we can reproduce production query shapes at scale.

Quick context: Opsly will run two-week side-by-side tests across three endpoints (clinical summarization, triage routing, and billing extraction). Our internal stake is high — procurement will weigh performance, cost per token, and failure rates.

What we'd like:
- 200k tokens of evaluation credit (usable across the three endpoints)
- 14-day validity window starting on activation
- Non-export clause (data stays within Redwood runtime)

I've attached our revised RFP (Opsly_RFP_v2.pdf) showing the evaluation criteria and sample load. Can you confirm if Redwood can issue this amount and whether there are any guardrails you need on our side?

Best,
Alex
Product Ops | Opsly Health
aporter@opsly.com
(415) 555-0182

From: dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Porter <aporter@opsly.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week side-by-side eval + additional credits

Alex — thanks for the RFP and clear scope. We can support a time-boxed credit allocation, but we need to put a few operational guardrails in place so the trial stays comparable and secure for both sides.

High-level proposal (subject to ops approval):
- Grant 200k tokens tied to deal DL-2026-0043
- Activation window: customer triggers within 30 days; once activated the credits expire after 14 days
- Rate limits to match production-like QPS (we'll align on the three endpoint routes)
- Export/data handling: runtime logs accessible to Opsly via our console for the trial, but no model weights or raw KV exports
- Require an evaluation summary and a short usage report at the end for internal billing and future credits

Lauren, can you confirm whether the 200k token amount needs to be broken into route-level allocations and whether a partial top-up is allowed if they exceed 85% of the pool? Ben — heads up in case we want to attach a promotional note to the deal.

Alex — if that sounds OK I'll follow up with the formal credit token and a short terms addendum.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com

From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com, Alex Porter <aporter@opsly.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week side-by-side eval + additional credits

TL;DR — Ops approves with governance. Details below.

Dylan / Alex — I've reviewed the RFP and load profile. We can approve a 200k token pool with the following governance to keep the comparison fair and auditable: 

- Allocation: 200,000 tokens total, allocated as 100k for clinical summarization, 60k for triage routing, 40k for billing extraction. These are soft partitions — tokens are drawn from the pool but we will track per-route consumption.
- Activation: Opsly to confirm activation window start time in writing. Activation must occur within 30 days of issuance.
- Expiry & throttling: Pool expires 14 days post-activation. We'll apply an auto-throttle at 85% consumption with a notification email to both parties. If Opsly requests a top-up, approvals required from Ben (growth credits) and Finance; top-ups subject to review.
- Reporting: Redwood will provide daily usage CSVs and a final evaluation export (anonymized request/response meta; no PII).
- Security & compliance: Trial runs on Redwood hosted (US) with logs retained for 30 days; exports of raw training data or KV caches are disallowed.
- Public statements: Any public claims about performance in side-by-side must be agreed upon with Redwood and attribute configuration versions.

Attachments: credit-approval-internal.pdf (internal approval stub).

Next steps: Dylan to confirm allocations with Opsly; I'll create the credit object in HubSpot and issue the token on activation once we get a signed acknowledgment of the governance terms.

Lauren Bishop
Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

From: dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Porter <aporter@opsly.com>, Maya Singh <maya@opsly.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week side-by-side eval + additional credits

Alex / Maya — thanks for the prompt turnaround. Per Ops we have approved the 200k token pool with the governance Lauren outlined. A few action items to get this live:

- Please reply to this thread with a one-line acceptance: “Opsly accepts Redwood trial governance and confirms activation window.”
- Confirm the intended activation start date (choose any date within the next 30 days).
- We'll issue the credit ID tied to HubSpot deal DL-2026-0043 and send a short terms addendum via DocuSign for signatures (no additional commercial paperwork required).

Once we have your acceptance and start date, Lauren will create the credit object and I will move the deal to "Trial - Active" in HubSpot. Ben — flagging for awareness on promotional allocation; no extra discretionary credits attached unless Opsly requests a top-up.

Looking forward — let me know if Opsly needs any additional telemetry hooks during the run.

Best,
Dylan
